Maria: quick async standup for llama3-xxlq onboarding — short summary of what I did / blockers / plan

Maria: what I did: ran full evals on longform suite (10k prompts), added prompt_set v4, pushed model recipe to staging, smoke-tested embeddings
Maria: blockers: seeing quality regressions on long-form summarization (ROUGE-L dropped ~4.2 pts). also hit a flaky KV-cache mismatch when batch>1 that causes decode drift in a few seeds
Maria: today: triage the regressions, open prompt tweak PR, coordinate with infra for a kernel test and try fp16 vs int8-ql rollback

Aj: can you paste the eval diff and the exact command you ran?

Maria: sure — command + diff below:
```
./eval/run_eval.sh --model=llama3-xxlq --prompts=prompts/longform_v2.json --batch=8 --seed=42 --out=evals/xxlq_longform.json
```
Diff snippet:
ROUGE-L: baseline 0.412 -> 0.369 (-0.042)
BLEU: 0.21 -> 0.20 (-0.01)
Latency p50: 120ms -> 125ms

Ken: @Maria quick question — which quantization variant did you test? int8-ql or fp16?

Maria: int8-ql by default. I also tried fp16 rollback: ROUGE-L improved to ~0.395 but cost/latency increased. suspect quantization causes subtle tokenization/rounding artifacts on long contexts

Sasha: I pushed a small prompt tweak PR (#412) that shortens system instruction and moves clarifying examples into a separate prompt block. also added a targeted ablation eval for long-context coherence. link: https://github.com/redwood/evals/pull/412

Maria: thanks @Sasha — I'll add review notes. if the KV merge bug is real we should repro in isolation then decide kernel vs runtime fix. tagging @Leo for infra/engine help

Leo: I'll run a kernel config test on staging tonight and compare batch=1 vs batch=8 behavior. any reproduction hints?

Maria: suspect off-by-one in chunked KV merging when prefix_cache=true with batching. quick repro:
```
python reproduce_kv.py --model llama3-xxlq --batch 8 --prefix_cache true
```
It fails ~3/100 seeds locally.

CI Bot: Deploy pipeline succeeded: build/llama3-xxlq-staging #287 passed :white_check_mark:

Aj: cool. I'll add a small coherence metric (custom score) to the evals repo to isolate the failure mode — will add PR later today

Sasha: added a comment on PR #412 to include the coherence eval and edge-case prompts (very long lists / nested bullets)

Ken: thanks team. If you want pair debugging on the KV repro tomorrow I can help in the morning (PST)

Maria: appreciate it — I'll post an update after the kernel test and after we land the prompt tweak. :thumbsup:
